rows.name: MC-SF
rows.action: Keep admitted jobs running; select waiting jobs using predicted upper lengths and future memory feasibility.
rows.boundary: Targets total completion latency in a non-preemptive round model. Our FIFO peak adapter omits shortest-first subset selection; it is not full MC-SF.

rows.name: WAIT
rows.locator: v4 abstract; detailed thresholds not reproduced
rows.action: Gate admission with fluid-guided thresholds; Nested WAIT regulates decode segments and adds a memory safety buffer.
rows.boundary: Known-length and unknown-length variants target stability and latency. Memory headroom is prior art; our measurements concern native offload recovery.

rows.name: Andes
rows.action: Prioritize and preempt at token boundaries using expected user-experience gain and GPU resource demand.
rows.boundary: Targets smooth streaming and prompt first output. Our fixed maxgap/stall metrics do not reproduce its reading-aware utility.

rows.name: FastServe
rows.action: Use skip-join multilevel feedback queues initialized from prompt length, with token-level preemption and proactive host/GPU state movement.
rows.boundary: Targets job latency through priority and execution quanta. HORIZON retains native quanta and changes admission/recovery/victim decisions.

rows.name: FastSwitch
rows.action: Group KV blocks, adapt synchronous/asynchronous swaps, and reuse valid CPU KV copies to reduce switching cost.
rows.boundary: Changes layout and transfer execution for fairness-aware serving. Our fixed native transfer path cannot reproduce its system-level benefit.

rows.name: UniBoost
rows.action: Unify prefill/decode priorities from arrival and attained work; quantize revisions and protect a dispatched request until its next service threshold.
rows.boundary: MemGuard already provides minimum-run protection. Our step-based lease and peer-growth gate are a different implementation, not proof of novelty or superiority.

rows.name: SuperInfer
rows.action: Rotate requests by SLO-derived virtual lag under a transfer budget; overlap full-duplex KV movement with computation.
rows.boundary: Designed for GH200 HBM/Grace memory and C2C transfers. Its proactive rotary scheduling and transfer engine are not reproduced by our single-GPU adapter.

rows.name: Llumnix
rows.action: Reschedule running requests across model instances using live migration for load balancing, isolation, and priority.
rows.boundary: Requires multiple instances and migration. Our experiment has one serving GPU; its remaining loss does not test distributed rescheduling.

rows.name: vLLM
rows.locator: PagedAttention paper abstract; runtime independently pinned in FACTS.md
rows.action: Allocate KV in pages and share blocks to reduce fragmentation and duplicate storage.
rows.boundary: The original paper motivates memory management. Native victim/LOAD/ACK behavior here is established from pinned 0.26 source, not attributed to the 2023 paper.

semantics: Primary-source action comparison. Locators state the evidence depth. No unimplemented method is presented as a measured baseline.
